Most of what you call facts may just be someone's opinion.

Kevin Trudeau says most people get hung up on the facts and on how something is going to work. They can't figure it out, so they get stuck.

He says the right attitude is different: it doesn't look like it can be done, but we're making the decision to do it anyway.

He calls that the correct attitude, and says that with it the facts bend to your will.

What fact have you accepted that might only be an opinion?
